note: Generic OBD-II diagnostic trouble codes (SAE J2012 / ISO 15031-6 wording, shortened). Generic codes mean the same on every make; codes whose second character is 1 are the maker's own and need the maker's list. A code names a circuit or a symptom, not the broken part. [table]

systems.U: network (control units talking to each other)

p_groups.0: fuel and air metering, auxiliary emission controls
p_groups.2: fuel and air metering: injector circuits
p_groups.5: vehicle speed, idle control, auxiliary inputs

P0011: Intake camshaft timing over-advanced or system performance (bank 1)
P0014: Exhaust camshaft timing over-advanced or system performance (bank 1)
P0016: Crankshaft and camshaft position do not agree (bank 1, sensor A)
P0030: Oxygen sensor heater control circuit (bank 1, sensor 1)
P0087: Fuel rail or system pressure too low
P0088: Fuel rail or system pressure too high
P0101: Mass air flow sensor range or performance
P0102: Mass air flow sensor circuit low
P0103: Mass air flow sensor circuit high
P0106: Manifold pressure sensor range or performance
P0113: Intake air temperature sensor circuit high
P0117: Engine coolant temperature sensor circuit low
P0118: Engine coolant temperature sensor circuit high
P0120: Throttle or pedal position sensor A circuit
P0121: Throttle or pedal position sensor A range or performance
P0122: Throttle or pedal position sensor A circuit low
P0123: Throttle or pedal position sensor A circuit high
P0125: Coolant temperature too low for closed-loop fuel control
P0128: Coolant thermostat: engine stays below regulating temperature
P0131: Oxygen sensor circuit low voltage (bank 1, sensor 1)
P0132: Oxygen sensor circuit high voltage (bank 1, sensor 1)
P0191: Fuel rail pressure sensor range or performance
P0336: Crankshaft position sensor A range or performance
P0341: Camshaft position sensor A range or performance (bank 1)
P0380: Glow plug or heater circuit A
P0404: Exhaust gas recirculation range or performance
P0441: Evaporative emission system incorrect purge flow
P0446: Evaporative emission system vent control circuit
P0456: Evaporative emission system very small leak
P0457: Evaporative emission system leak: fuel cap loose or off
P0501: Vehicle speed sensor A range or performance
P0520: Engine oil pressure sensor or switch circuit
P0521: Engine oil pressure sensor range or performance
P0522: Engine oil pressure sensor circuit low
P0604: Control module random access memory error
P0700: Transmission control system has requested the engine light
P0715: Input or turbine speed sensor circuit
P0741: Torque converter clutch performance or stuck off
P2002: Diesel particulate filter efficiency below threshold (bank 1)
P2101: Throttle actuator control motor range or performance
P2135: Throttle or pedal position sensors A and B do not agree
P2138: Throttle or pedal position sensors D and E do not agree
P2195: Oxygen sensor signal stuck lean (bank 1, sensor 1)
P2196: Oxygen sensor signal stuck rich (bank 1, sensor 1)
P2263: Turbocharger or supercharger boost system performance
P242F: Diesel particulate filter restriction: ash accumulation
P2463: Diesel particulate filter restriction: soot accumulation
P20EE: Selective catalytic reduction NOx catalyst efficiency below threshold (bank 1)

U0100: Lost communication with the engine control module
U0101: Lost communication with the transmission control module
U0121: Lost communication with the anti-lock brake control module
U0140: Lost communication with the body control module
U0155: Lost communication with the instrument cluster

ranges: Ignition coil {letter} primary or secondary circuit (coil {n})

urgency.stop: stop safely and switch off; driving on risks the engine or your safety
urgency.now: do not put it off: drive gently, avoid load and motorways, have it read today or tomorrow
urgency.soon: book a diagnosis within days; the car is usually driveable
urgency.later: low urgency; often an emissions housekeeping fault
